title: Employment Contract Analysis
summary: This document is an employment contract between Alex Example (the employee) and Synthetic Systems Sdn. Bhd. (the employer) for a software engineering role starting January 1, 2:00, 2027, with a monthly salary of RM12,000. The contract establishes that either party can terminate the agreement with sixty days written notice, and the employee has an obligation to protect confidential business information.
plainLanguageExplanation:
Either party may terminate the contract by giving sixty days written notice.

The employee must protect confidential business information.

The employee must protect confidential business information as a key obligation under the contract

The salary is paid monthly at RM12,000

The employment begins on January 1, 2027
